name: bookmarks
description: Bookmarks and vim-style marks inside Claude Code conversations: mark a line, jump back, keep a reading position, browse your prompts, and let Claude cite earlier places as clickable links.

settingsShown.title: ▸ Bookmarks
settingsShown.description: true: the plugin's settings appear below (the prompts list, the band, the lists' rows, debugging, colours, and the keys behind their own row); false: folded away, and everything you set still applies

listOpensAt.title: Prompts list opens at
listOpensAt.description: nearest: centred on the prompt nearest your view; newest: at the newest prompt

followHere.title: Prompts list follows the view
followHere.description: when-idle: slides to keep the yellow row showing unless you are typing a number; always; never

closeShare.title: Closeness for the earlier prompt
closeShare.description: An earlier exchange is "nearest" while it holds at least this share of the screen lines the biggest one holds (0 to 1)

paneAfterJump.title: Prompts or bookmarks list after you pick a row
paneAfterJump.description: close: clicking a row (or Enter on a number) jumps there and closes the list; stay: the list stays open for the next pick

paneWhileTyping.title: A list while you type
paneWhileTyping.description: stay: typing in the input box leaves an open list where it is; close: typing closes it

afterActionFocus.title: Keyboard after an action
afterActionFocus.description: input: back to the input box once Claude Code allows a plugin to do it; band: stay in the band

palette.title: Colour overrides
palette.description: JSON, e.g. {"here": {"color": "cyan"}, "markBand": {"backgroundColor": "#203040"}}. Roles: here, pinned, footnote, legend, heading, mark, markBand, used, unused, unreached, emphasis, search. A colour is a theme key (warning, subtle, ...), a terminal colour name or #rrggbb; anything else is ignored

footnotes.title: Footnotes in the prompts list
footnotes.description: folded: a prompt with footnotes (your slash commands, ! shell commands, interruptions) shows an ellipsis, and . unfolds them; shown: always listed under their prompt; hidden: never listed

promptTextBudget.title: Prompt text kept for the filter (bytes)
promptTextBudget.description: How much of your prompts the filter searches, across the conversation; 0 = unlimited (for machines with room to spare). The default keeps whole prompts in most conversations

band.title: The band
band.description: full: the command field, the labelled commands and ? for the rest; field: the command field alone, one short row (the leader still lands there; ? shows the commands)

chords.title: Chords on their own keybindings
chords.description: on: mark, jump, prompts and read also answer the keybindings bound to their borrowed actions (docs: Optional fast keys); off: only the leader and the band's field

panes.title: Lists in a pane
panes.description: on: the prompts and bookmarks lists open in a pane beside the conversation; off: p and b take a number in the band and jump, with no pane

listInput.title: Typing a list number
listInput.description: auto: the best way this Claude Code build allows (today the band's own field); field: the band's own field, where Backspace, /words and * work; buttons: one key per digit, as before 0.6.27

pinScope.title: Pins shown in a list
pinScope.description: here: a list shows the pins made in it; everywhere: a list shows a pin on any of its rows, wherever it was made

searchShown.title: ▸ Search: show the search rows
searchShown.description: true: the rows below set what the search pane opens on, its toggle row, and how a result is labelled and laid out; false: they are folded away (what you set stays)

searchToggles.title: Search: the row of toggles
searchToggles.description: shown: the search pane draws a row of on/off toggles for what it searches (you, claude, tools, outputs, agents, ...); hidden: no row, and in:tools style words in the query still narrow it

searchView.title: Search: what it opens on
searchView.description: all: every row; you+claude+sessions+tools+outputs: what the conversation shows on screen, other sessions' messages included; you+claude+sessions: the conversation and other sessions' messages; custom: the kinds you turn on in the rows below. The toggles change it while the pane is open

searchWithYou.title: Search: custom includes you
searchWithYou.description: true: a search with "what it opens on" set to custom starts with you on; false: off

searchWithClaude.title: Search: custom includes claude
searchWithClaude.description: true: a search with "what it opens on" set to custom starts with claude on; false: off

searchWithAgents.title: Search: custom includes agents
searchWithAgents.description: true: a search with "what it opens on" set to custom starts with agents on; false: off

searchWithSessions.title: Search: custom includes sessions
searchWithSessions.description: true: a search with "what it opens on" set to custom starts with sessions on; false: off

searchWithTools.title: Search: custom includes tools
searchWithTools.description: true: a search with "what it opens on" set to custom starts with tools on; false: off

searchWithOutputs.title: Search: custom includes outputs
searchWithOutputs.description: true: a search with "what it opens on" set to custom starts with outputs on; false: off

searchWithThinking.title: Search: custom includes thinking
searchWithThinking.description: true: a search with "what it opens on" set to custom starts with thinking on; false: off

searchWithNotices.title: Search: custom includes notices
searchWithNotices.description: true: a search with "what it opens on" set to custom starts with notices on; false: off

searchWithOther.title: Search: custom includes other
searchWithOther.description: true: a search with "what it opens on" set to custom starts with other on; false: off

searchLabels.title: Search: how a result says what it is
searchLabels.description: words: you, claude, thinking, Bash, output, notice; short: the first letters of each (yo, cl, th, ou, no at 2; a tool keeps its name, an agent its type), on the result rows; the toggles keep their words

searchShortLength.title: Search: letters in a short kind
searchShortLength.description: How many letters a short kind keeps (1 to 6): 2 gives cl, ou, th; 3 gives cla, out, thi. Used while "how a result says what it is" is short

searchLayout.title: Search: how a result is laid out
searchLayout.description: stacked: the number and kind on one line, the text on the lines below, indented; inline: the text beside the kind. With one line per row, always inline

searchImplied.title: Search: labels in a one-kind view
searchImplied.description: implied: with one toggle on, a label that only repeats it is left out (claude alone: replies unlabelled, thinking still says so); always: every result keeps its label

rowLines.title: Lines per row in the lists
rowLines.description: How many lines each prompt in the prompts list, and each mark in the jump list, may take (1 to 5); the text is cut with an ellipsis at the end of the last line

keysShown.title: ▸ Keys: show the key rows
keysShown.description: true: the rows below set the band's keys, one per command, and the list keys; false: they are folded away (your keys stay as set)

keyMark.title: Keys: mark
keyMark.description: Keys for mark, separated by spaces (default: m); Space spells the space key; end with hidden to take its button off the bar; empty = the default

keyJump.title: Keys: jump
keyJump.description: Keys for jump, separated by spaces (default: ' j); Space spells the space key; end with hidden to take its button off the bar; empty = the default

keyPrompts.title: Keys: prompts
keyPrompts.description: Keys for prompts, separated by spaces (default: p); Space spells the space key; end with hidden to take its button off the bar; empty = the default

keyRead.title: Keys: reading position
keyRead.description: Keys for reading position, separated by spaces (default: Space r); Space spells the space key; end with hidden to take its button off the bar; empty = the default

keyBookmarks.title: Keys: bookmarks
keyBookmarks.description: Keys for bookmarks, separated by spaces (default: b); Space spells the space key; end with hidden to take its button off the bar; empty = the default

keyLists.title: Keys: lists
keyLists.description: Keys for lists, separated by spaces (default: l); Space spells the space key; end with hidden to take its button off the bar; empty = the default

keySearch.title: Keys: search
keySearch.description: Keys for search, separated by spaces (default: /); Space spells the space key; end with hidden to take its button off the bar; empty = the default

keyPromote.title: Keys: promote a mark
keyPromote.description: Keys for promote a mark, separated by spaces (default: P); Space spells the space key; end with hidden to take its button off the bar; empty = the default

keyDelete.title: Keys: clear a mark
keyDelete.description: Keys for clear a mark, separated by spaces (default: d); Space spells the space key; end with hidden to take its button off the bar; empty = the default

keyForget.title: Keys: forget a mark
keyForget.description: Keys for forget a mark, separated by spaces (default: D); Space spells the space key; end with hidden to take its button off the bar; empty = the default

keyBack.title: Keys: back
keyBack.description: Keys for back, separated by spaces (default: o); Space spells the space key; end with hidden to take its button off the bar; empty = the default

keyForward.title: Keys: forward
keyForward.description: Keys for forward, separated by spaces (default: i); Space spells the space key; end with hidden to take its button off the bar; empty = the default

keyClose.title: Keys: close
keyClose.description: Keys for close, separated by spaces (default: q); Space spells the space key; end with hidden to take its button off the bar; empty = the default

keyHelp.title: Keys: help
keyHelp.description: Keys for help, separated by spaces (default: ?); Space spells the space key; end with hidden to take its button off the bar; empty = the default

keyList.title: Keys: in a list
keyList.description: The list keys in order: next previous pin previous-group next-group claim remove close (default: j k s h l c d q); empty = the defaults

keyLeader.title: Keys: the leader
keyLeader.description: The leader is a Claude Code keybinding (abovePrompt:focus in ~/.claude/keybindings.json), not set here

debugShown.title: ▸ Debug: show the debug rows
debugShown.description: true: the rows below set what the debug log echoes and quotes; false: they are folded away (what you set stays)

debugDefault.title: Debug: echo by default
debugDefault.description: Whether the plugin's log lines are echoed into a conversation that has not chosen; /bm-debug decides per conversation

debugText.title: Debug: conversation text in the log
debugText.description: auto: off in an installed plugin, always in one loaded from a folder; off: log lines name places by id only; with-debug: they also quote the conversation while this conversation's debugging is on; always: they always quote it

debugTextLength.title: Debug: how much text a line quotes
debugTextLength.description: reference: a short excerpt, enough to find the place; full: the whole text
